structured.feedback: Mostly solid (no weaknesses, no fabricated quotes, no links, subheadings present), but it misses explicit instructions: several passive constructions ("is formulated," "is 100% vegan," "It's formulated without") despite the active-voice requirement, repetitive wording ("vegan" appears four times, "soft and kissable" and "Rebel Sol" recur), and features and benefits are not clearly distinguished. It also runs about 185 words, a bit under the ~200 target.
